main.description: Space read policy and delegated group-DID OAuth grants, authored by the space authority in its own repo in that space. Roles resolve against this group members/self. In a personal invites space, public must be false and both arrays empty: owner-only reads are mandatory and group role grants do not apply.

record.description: Read access is public OR the member holds any readRoles role. Acceptance is not required. Empty readRoles with public=false admits no members through this policy. The authority retains control of its own data.

public.description: Allow any user to obtain a read credential, regardless of membership. Protocol credential requirements still apply.

readRoles.description: Distinct role IDs declared by this group. Unknown roles and duplicate entries must be rejected.

grants.description: Group-DID OAuth scopes available to holders of each role. Grants do not themselves confer space read access.
